item.title: The SASQUATCH ODYSSEY! - Trekking the Forests For BIGFOOT (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Brian King-Sharp is an author, researcher, and podcaster whose lifelong fascination with Sasquatch began in the mountains of northwestern Georgia. After a mysterious childhood encounter sparked his interest in Bigfoot, Brian spent years exploring the unexplained while building a successful 16-year career in law enforcement. What began as a hobby eventually became a full-time passion when his podcast, Sasquatch Odyssey, grew into one of the most recognized shows dedicated to firsthand Bigfoot encounters. Through interviews with eyewitnesses and field investigations in North Carolina and British Columbia, Brian continues his search for answers to one of North America's greatest mysteries.

Brian is also the author of Sasquatch Unleashed: The Truth Behind the Legend, a book exploring the evidence, encounters, and enduring mystery surrounding Bigfoot. He hosts several popular podcasts, including Backwoods Horror Stories and That Bigfoot Podcast, and is the founder and CEO of Paranormal World Productions, LLC. His work has been featured on television through Vice and Tubi, and he has spoken at Sasquatch conferences and festivals across the United States and United Kingdom. With years of research, countless witness interviews, and firsthand field experience, Brian brings a unique perspective to the ongoing search for Sasquatch.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
